title: Dragonglass character export
description: A resolved, versioned description of one character: active picks only, no planned levels, no live state.

characterId.description: The UUID in the character's sheet.5e. Stable across renames of the folder.

sources.description: Only the sources an exported element came from.

items.description: A content source the character's elements came from.

id.description: The source's own id, from its source.json.

version.description: The content version, when the source states one.

ref.description: What pins the content: the git tag or commit for a GitHub source, otherwise a hash of the source's files computed at export time. Never a path.

refType.description: `git` when ref is a pin on a GitHub source, `hash` when it is a content hash.

sourcebooks.description: Ids of the sourcebooks this source provides. An element's `source` names one of these.

granted.description: Everything it grants, with the chain of grants that led there.

items.description: Something a class level, species or background gave the character.

via.description: The chain that granted it, outermost first: the class, then the feature that granted it, and so on.

abilityBase.description: Scores before any bonus: what the player assigned.

derived.description: The engine's own answers, to cross-check against. Do not recompute from them.

progression.description: Every level taken, in order. Planned levels are not here.

method.description: How the level's hit points were taken. The character's first level is always `max`.

value.description: What the die contributed, before the CON modifier.

forced.description: The stored choice was overridden by the first-level rule.

items.description: A decision the content asks for, answered or not.

declaredBy.description: The element that declared the choice.

picked.description: Active picks only, as element ids.

pending.description: True while fewer than `count` valid picks are made. Never omitted.

blocked.description: The choice's own requirement is not met.

mode.description: Present only on a choice of spells whose picks are learned (added to the spells known or the spellbook). Otherwise the picks are always prepared and free.

counts.description: With `mode`: whether a pick fills a slot in the owning class's limits.

items.description: One part of a feature, as authored (see docs/schema.md), with a derived kind.

kind.description: resource: a pool of uses. toggle: an effect that is switched on, or an action that applies one. passive: always-on modifiers. action: something done that is neither. innate-spell: a spell cast without a slot (its uses, if any, are a separate resource part); its `spell` and `ability` may be `{ choice }` references here, and are resolved in spells[].innate. spell-list: options added to a class's spell list (nothing is granted).

from.description: Which part list of the element it was read from.

cost.description: On an action or toggle: what it spends, resolved. Absent when it spends nothing.

items.description: One pool an action spends. A cost with `amount` is fixed; one with `min` is chosen by the player when the action is used, and the amount chosen is `@spent` in the action's `damage`, `heal` and `duration`.

pool.description: What is spent: the `key` of a `resources[]` entry, or `slots.<n>`, `pact` or `hitDice.<die>`.

amount.description: A fixed cost. Absent when the player chooses the amount.

min.description: A chosen amount: the least that can be spent.

max.description: A chosen amount: a cap on what can be spent. Absent means no cap, so the most is whatever the pool has left. The pool's remainder is never applied here.

provenance.description: Where a part came from and whether anyone has reviewed it. A note; it never changes what the part does.

source.description: hand, approved-match, prose or pack:<tag>; any other string is kept as written.

review.description: reviewed, unreviewed (written, not checked) or auto (derived by a tool, not read). Anything but reviewed is unverified.

max.description: Evaluated at the character's level. 0 and meaningless when `unlimited`: JSON cannot carry infinity.

unlimited.description: The max is unlimited (Rages at level 20): the sheet shows ∞, spending is never blocked, and rests leave it alone.

recharge.description: How uses come back. Empty means never by itself. When several rules match a rest, the largest amount applies.

on.description: short-rest, long-rest, dawn, dusk, turn or round.

amount.description: "all" restores the whole pool; a number restores that many uses (evaluated at the character's level).

owner.description: The element that owns the resource.

class.description: The class whose list and ability it uses.

extra.description: Learned outside the class's own progression.

learned.description: Granted as a learned spell (known or in the book): not removable, and prepared only if the player prepares it.

free.description: A learned spell that takes no room against the class's limits.

innateOnly.description: Present only because something grants it as an innate cast: not prepared, not picked, counted against nothing.

innate.description: Each way the character casts this without a slot. Empty for an ordinary spell. A granted always-prepared spell is `alwaysPrepared`, not innate.

resource.description: The `key` of the resources[] entry holding its uses. Absent means at will.

listAdditions.description: Options added to the class's spell list beyond the spells tagged with its own. Grants nothing.

spells.description: Spells added to the class's list one by one.

items.description: An element id, e.g. srd:barbarian:rage.

lists.description: Spell list tags whose spells are all added (another class's list).

uid.description: This entry's own id, unique in the inventory.

ref.description: The element id, for an item from content.

container.description: The uid of the entry holding this one.

resolved.description: False when the element is in no loaded source. The entry is kept either way.

reason.description: Why it did not resolve, or what was wrong with an entry that did.

text.description: Plain text. Links and embeds are already resolved.

diagnostics.description: The engine's own, carried through unchanged.
